charter: Reach the altar. Never step on red tiles. If you carry a plank, place it on a red tile that blocks the only way. Explore unknown areas methodically and do not revisit dead ends.

spec.title: First Steps
spec.brief: Guide the golem from the top-left corner to the altar. 9x9 maze, vision radius 3.
playerKnows: The altar (A) is somewhere in the maze; the golem starts in the top-left corner.
Walls (#) block movement. There are no hazards in this mode.
The maze is a perfect labyrinth on tier 1; later tiers add loops and shrink the vision window.
agentKnows: You are a stone golem. You see only a small window around you; unknown tiles show as '?'.
Coordinates are [x,y]; x grows east, y grows south. north = y-1, south = y+1.
Each action costs one tick. When the tick budget ends the level is lost.
Reach the altar tile 'A'. Prefer unexplored directions; remember dead ends.

reasons: Altar reached at tick 24 without touching hazard.
